name: Paul
note: The apostle, writing as a spiritual father to a church he had to leave.

name: Silvanus
note: Paul's co-worker (Silas), who helped found the church in Thessalonica.

name: Timothy
note: Sent back to Thessalonica to strengthen the believers; returned with good news (3:2-6).

name: The believers in Thessalonica
note: Mostly Gentiles who turned from idols, now suffering for their faith.

name: The Lord Jesus
note: Whose return the church awaits, and who rescues from the coming wrath.

name: The churches of Judea
note: Early believers who suffered at the hands of their own people (2:14), whom the Thessalonians imitate.

name: Satan
note: Who hindered Paul from returning (2:18) and the tempter Paul feared (3:5).

name: The leaders
note: Those who "labor among you, and are over you in the Lord" (5:12).

name: The Gentiles who don't know God
note: Those whose passion and lust the believers must not imitate (4:5).
